How Dream Achieve Moments uses health data

With your permission, Dream Achieve Moments reads three things from Health Connect: your daily step total, how long you slept, and your exercise sessions with their type and length. It saves one short entry per day for each on this phone, where you can review, delete or export them. Nothing is sent anywhere. Turn the Health source off in Sources, or remove access in Health Connect, at any time.
